divergences.description: spec-2-1 task 'ios/Runner/Info.plist -- add NSFaceIDUsageDescription' is marked done, but the diff never touches ios/Runner/Info.plist. Without this key the iOS Face ID prompt cannot appear.

spec-2-4's Code Map says the biometricEnabled stream should join _GoRouterRefreshStream. The router only subscribes to the vault and session streams and reads currentBiometricEnabled synchronously when /vault is built. The reason given is that go_router does not re-invoke the builder for an unchanged match.

spec-2-4 says to fire-and-forget fetchBiometricEnabled() next to restoreSession(). The code instead awaits a bounded fetch (2s timeout) in main() before runApp(), and keeps a redundant second fire-and-forget fetch in initState.
spec-2-4's Design Notes say 'no new tokens', but new DesignTokens were added for an inline saving spinner (size and stroke width) next to the Configurações toggle.

spec-2-3's frozen Never clause forbids changes to vault_lock_screen.dart. The diff still changes it (and the coupled pin_keypad.dart): a 10s submitPin timeout with its own error copy, plus the PinKeypad enabled/disabled state.

Visual 'corrections' for Story 2.1 and 2.2 that no plan mentions: a redesigned biometric view (96px fingerprint circle, 'Toque para desbloquear' / Face ID copy), a tinted PIN error band with icon and a new caption style, and a top-aligned pinScreenPadding. Each comes with new design tokens beyond the keypad tokens spec-2-2 called for.

spec-2-4 says the biometric preference fetch at boot is fire-and-forget, like restoreSession(). Instead, main() awaits fetchBiometricEnabled() (with a 2s timeout) before runApp. The fire-and-forget call in CerneApp.initState is kept as a redundant re-fetch.

spec-2-4's Code Map says biometricEnabledStream should join _GoRouterRefreshStream. It was not added: refreshListenable subscribes only to the vault and session streams. The code comment says go_router 18.1.1 never re-invokes the route builder for an unchanged route match, so the entry would do nothing.
spec-2-4's Design Notes say 'no new tokens'. The diff adds new design tokens for an inline saving spinner on the Configurações screen, and the screen shows that spinner while a toggle is saving.

spec-2-3's frozen Never clause forbids changes to vault_lock_screen.dart. The vault lock screen still carries changes from spec-2-3's own review: the 10s submitPin timeout, the PinKeypad enabled flag, and clearing the stale error on a new attempt.
VaultLockScreen gains a didUpdateWidget branch that switches to the PIN keypad when attemptBiometricFirst changes from true to false. spec-2-4 only says to gate initState on that flag.

The diff adds visual 'corrections' that no plan describes: a fingerprint icon circle with Face ID/Touch ID copy on the biometric view, and a tinted PIN error band with an icon and a new caption type style. These come with tokens beyond the PIN-keypad-only tokens spec-2-2 planned (colorErrorBg, textCaptionSm, biometricIcon*, pinErrorBand*, pinScreenPadding).

A superseded call is signalled by returning Failure.malformedResponse with a shared sentinel message, which the cubit matches by string to hide it from the UI. Story 2.4 does use malformedResponse for parse failures, but none of the specs defines this sentinel use.
